description: A closed black hard case sits on the table in front of you, with foam compartments and small items inside once opened. The left hand comes in to the front latch area while the right hand presses and lifts the lid upward to open the case; then the right hand reaches into the foam, removes a light gray oblong item and sets it down on the table, and next lifts out a small white-and-yellow item and places it beside the gray piece while the left hand stays nearby without holding anything.
